prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a single character turnaround sprite sheet for a gothic RPG, visually compatible with 32-bit Castlevania and Ragnarok Online inspired pixel art. Original main character: a lanky white adult man with light skin, long thin limbs and relaxed posture, wearing an oversized plain white T-shirt with a clear small red-capped mushroom illustration printed on its chest, loose dark trousers and worn shoes. Keep the outfit contemporary and simple. Exactly eight separate full-body idle sprites of the same character, once each, on a regular 4-column by 2-row grid: front, front-left, left profile, back-left, back, back-right, right profile, front-right. Equal apparent height, same hairstyle and body proportions in each direction, evenly spaced, consistent baseline in each row, no overlap, no cropped feet or hair. The mushroom print is visible only where the shirt front is visible. Deliberate pixel clusters, dark outlines, restrained Gothic palette, no scene, no borders, no lettering or labels, no extra characters, transparent background.
